active_continuity: The familiar voice that told Cheongpung he had broken free of his shell belongs to Sword Saint Mae Jonghak, Cheongpung's grandfather.
Mae Jonghak is the true identity of Jongni Chu and has spent the past year traveling after unexpectedly Returning to Youth.
Mae Jonghak killed the Heaven-Poison Demon Lord after the Great Faction War and bears the title Sword Saint.
Mae Jonghak reached Great Completion and then attained higher enlightenment after encountering another martial wall.
Mae Jonghak's restored cherished sword can unleash a divine version of the Thirty-Six Plum Blossom Swords.
The Blood Lord's final arm was severed while he was attacking Cheongpung and resisting Mae Jonghak.
Jin Taekyung remained conscious despite his injuries and restrained the Blood Lord's ankle to prevent his escape.
The Blood Lord escaped with the Green Jade Buddha Staff inside ominous black radiance.
open_questions: What is the Blood Lord's true identity and the nature of the black radiance that carried him away?
